description: Load a skill: step-by-step guidance for one kind of task. Call it with the exact name from the catalog below when a skill fits the current step; the text comes back inside <skill_content>. Pass file to load one of the files the skill lists.
name: activate_skill

file.description: One of the files the skill lists, relative to the skill directory

description: Ask the user a question and wait for the answer. Use it only when the task cannot continue without the user's decision.
name: ask_user

description: Finish the task and report the outcome. Call it once, when the work is done, partly done or blocked.
name: finish

evidence.description: Checks that confirm the result: commands, file paths, test names

result.description: What was done and the answer

status.description: done: the goal is reached; partial: only part of it; blocked: cannot continue

description: Ask the user for access to a path outside the project. Use it before reading or writing there; the user approves or denies.
name: request_grant

mode.description: ro: read only; rw: read and write
